caveat: Measured on one developer machine against local containers, with ClickHouse sharing a 4GB VM with Kafka and PostgreSQL. Comparable to another run on the same machine; not to anything else. Trust p50: on this machine the tail moves with whatever else is running, and `max` is recorded so that is visible rather than hidden inside a percentile.
